blind.description: A stylized wooden door leaf featuring a six-pane glazed upper section and a recessed rectangular wooden panel below. It is equipped with spherical brass/gold knobs on both front and back faces. The surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled with hand-painted woodgrain texture and frosted greenish-white glass panes. It rests upright directly on its flat bottom edge without an additional base.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal rectangle representing the door's top edge, flanked by two small circular golden knobs protruding from opposite sides near the right end.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 5 ft 4 in to 5 ft 6 in tall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 ft wide.

notes: door leaf is slightly thick due to protruding doorknobs
